description: Scoped service that centralises all Notion-editor keyboard shortcuts. Usage: // In a Blazor component: [Inject] private NotionKeyboardManager KeyboardManager { get; set; } = default!; private Task OnKeyDown(KeyboardEventArgs e) { var action = KeyboardManager.HandleKeyDown(e); if (action is NotionEditorAction.Bold) { ... } return Task.CompletedTask; } Subscribers may also listen to for a decoupled, event-driven integration.

members.name: GetShortcutCategories
members.description: Returns all shortcuts grouped into instances, ready for display in a help panel.

members.name: HandleKeyDown
members.description: Processes a event, fires if a matching shortcut is found, and returns the matched action. Returns null when no binding matches.

members.name: Register
members.description: Adds a custom shortcut binding. A binding for the same action is replaced.

members.name: Unregister
members.description: Removes all bindings for the specified action.
